description: Free: look up an agent in Concordium's Agent Registry (CIS-8004) by its badge, the CIS-2 token address an Agent Card carries, or by the longer Agent ID that Concordium's registry app shows. Returns whether the badge is valid (Active, the card at agent_uri hashes to the metadata_hash on chain, and that card carries this badge), the owner account (tied to a verified identity), the agent wallet, the origins the card lists, and the CIS-8 key the agent binds with the address it stands for and whether the CIS-8 registry still holds it. To check the payTos of an x402 endpoint against its seller's badge, use x402_payee_check. Read-only. Shares the free limit of 10 calls per hour.

badge.description: The badge (e.g. Mf22oVsbu3vf4Jb1cga49), its ccd:<genesis>/cis-2:<address> form, or the registry app's Agent ID

name: concordium_badge_check

issues.description: Why it is not valid; empty when valid

network.description: mainnet or testnet, from the badge's own registry contract

owner.description: The owner account: a Concordium account, tied to a verified identity at the protocol level

title: Concordium badge lookup (free)
